overall: The AG found the Easton School Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by receiving only one final superintendent candidate, because the selection process was conducted entirely in open session; the withdrawn notice claim was not reached.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee received only one recommended candidate for Superintendent and was required to conduct final interviews of at least two candidates.
allegations.key_passage: Here, where the Committee and the Subcommittee only met in open session while conducting the Superintendent selection process, the limitations of Purpose 8 were inapplicable.

allegations.summary: Original complaint alleged a February 27 meeting was held without proper notice; the complainant withdrew this allegation in the request for further review.
allegations.key_passage: However, the complainant withdrew this allegation in the request for further review.
